div.div:
The operator sets targets in Luna. The Operating Modes turn them into plant setpoints, the Power Control splits them safely between the devices and the Device Service
writes them to the devices. Measurements flow back, so the plant follows the targets at the grid connection. Dashed: future parts and development tools.
